concept.title: Introduction
concept.shortdesc: The Acadian AIO printer is great choice for home offices and small businesses. It is a true All-In-One printer.

section.title: Printer
section.p: Print color or black and white documents quickly and easily from your computer. The AIO printer has settings to properly print stapled documents, booklets, brochures, and posters.

You can print photos from your computer or memory cards. In addition to controlling the picture print quality, you can enlarge or reduce photos, print them without borders, and manipulate the color settings.

section.title: Copier
section.p: You can copy and collate large documents using the automatic document feeder (ADF) and copy double-sided documents onto single or double-sided pages. If you have multiple small items, such as receipts, that you need to copy onto a single page, you can use the Document Glass instead of the ADF.

section.title: Scanner
section.p: If you want to create a digital file of a document or photo, scan it in and select which format in which you want to store it. You can scan single or multiple page documents in one or more files.

section.title: Fax Machine
section.p: You can quickly send or receive faxes using efficiency features, such as storing commonly dialed phone numbers.

section.title: Photo Printing
section.p: You can easily print photos with the color printing features of the AIO printer.
